title: Acacia as the Tree of Life in Egypt, Freemasonry and the Ark of the Covenant

tellings.quote: life or the the acacia tree being the Tree of Life in Egypt and then in Freemasonry The Acacia Leaf is is a big is a kind of place prominent it plays a role in Freemasonry and um there's there's no doubt about it the wood out of which the Ark of the Covenant was made was acacia wood

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels, talking with a guest named Graham Hancock, describes how the acacia tree keeps showing up in sacred traditions. He says that in ancient Egypt the acacia was the Tree of Life, that the acacia leaf plays a prominent role in Freemasonry, a centuries-old fraternal society with its own secret symbols, and that the Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest described in the Bible, was made of acacia wood. He raises it as a thread that might link these old traditions to a shared source.
